topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Present Progressive – Statements – Contracted forms
title: Present Progressive: Short Forms in Statements

explanation.tr:
Olumlu cümlelerde konuşma dilinde kısaltmalar kullanılır:
• I am → I'm: I'm reading.
• you are → you're, we are → we're, they are → they're
• he is → he's, she is → she's, it is → it's
• İsimlerle de olur: Tom's working. (= Tom is working)
Dikkat: its (onun) ≠ it's (it is).
explanation.tk:
Tassyklaýjy sözlemlerde gürleşik dilinde gysgaltmalar ulanylýar:
• I am → I'm: I'm reading.
• you are → you're, we are → we're, they are → they're
• he is → he's, she is → she's, it is → it's
• Atlar bilen hem bolýar: Tom's working. (= Tom is working)
Üns beriň: its (onuň) ≠ it's (it is).
explanation.ru:
В утвердительных предложениях в разговоре используют сокращения:
• I am → I'm: I'm reading.
• you are → you're, we are → we're, they are → they're
• he is → he's, she is → she's, it is → it's
• С существительными тоже: Tom's working. (= Tom is working)
Внимание: its (его) ≠ it's (it is).

examples.en: I'm cooking pasta.
She's talking on the phone.
We're waiting for the bus.
It's getting dark.
They're having fun.
Tom's fixing his bike.

exercises.question: Find the mistake: "Your making a mistake."

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Present Progressive – Statements – Long forms
title: Present Progressive: Long Forms in Statements

explanation.tr:
Uzun biçimde am/is/are tam yazılır:
• I am working.
• He is / She is / It is working.
• You are / We are / They are working.
Uzun biçim yazılı ve resmî İngilizcede, ayrıca vurgu yaparken kullanılır: I AM listening! (Gerçekten dinliyorum!)
explanation.tk:
Uzyn görnüşde am/is/are doly ýazylýar:
• I am working.
• He is / She is / It is working.
• You are / We are / They are working.
Uzyn görnüş ýazmaça we resmi iňlis dilinde, şeýle hem nygtalanda ulanylýar: I AM listening! (Hakykatdan diňleýärin!)
explanation.ru:
В полной форме am/is/are пишутся целиком:
• I am working.
• He is / She is / It is working.
• You are / We are / They are working.
Полная форма используется в письменной и официальной речи, а также для акцента: I AM listening! (Я правда слушаю!)

examples.en: I am learning English.
He is painting the wall.
They are visiting their grandparents.
The sun is shining.
We are building a snowman.
You are doing great!

exercises.question: I'm eating. → long form: I ___ eating.

Find the mistake: "The students is writing a test."

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Questions and short answers in the Present Progressive
title: Present Progressive: Questions and Short Answers

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive soru: Am/Is/Are + özne + fiil-ing?
• Are you listening? Is she sleeping? Am I talking too loud?
• Kısa cevaplar:
  Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
  Yes, he/she/it is. / No, he/she/it isn't.
  Yes, we/you/they are. / No, we/you/they aren't.
• Olumlu kısa cevapta kısaltma yok: Yes, she is. (✓) – Yes, she's. (✗)
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive sorag: Am/Is/Are + eýe + işlik-ing?
• Are you listening? Is she sleeping? Am I talking too loud?
• Gysga jogaplar:
  Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
  Yes, he/she/it is. / No, he/she/it isn't.
  Yes, we/you/they are. / No, we/you/they aren't.
• Tassyklaýjy gysga jogapda gysgaltma ýok: Yes, she is. (✓) – Yes, she's. (✗)
explanation.ru:
Вопрос в Present Progressive: Am/Is/Are + подлежащее + глагол-ing?
• Are you listening? Is she sleeping? Am I talking too loud?
• Краткие ответы:
  Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
  Yes, he/she/it is. / No, he/she/it isn't.
  Yes, we/you/they are. / No, we/you/they aren't.
• В утвердительном кратком ответе без сокращения: Yes, she is. (✓) – Yes, she's. (✗)

examples.en: Are you working? – Yes, I am.
Is it raining? – No, it isn't.
Are they playing? – Yes, they are.
Is your mum cooking? – No, she isn't.
Am I disturbing you? – No, you aren't.
Is the baby sleeping? – Yes, he is.

exercises.question: Find the mistake: "Is the children sleeping?"

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Questions in the Present Progressive
title: Present Progressive: Making Questions

explanation.tr:
Olumlu cümleyi soruya çevirmek için am/is/are'yı öznenin önüne al:
• She is reading. → Is she reading?
• They are eating. → Are they eating?
• You are working. → Are you working?
• I am late. → Am I late?
Fiil-ing aynı kalır. Sonuna soru işareti koymayı unutma.
explanation.tk:
Tassyklaýjy sözlemi soraga öwürmek üçin am/is/are-y eýäniň öňüne geçir:
• She is reading. → Is she reading?
• They are eating. → Are they eating?
• You are working. → Are you working?
• I am late. → Am I late?
Işlik-ing üýtgemeýär. Ahyrynda sorag belgisini goýmagy ýatdan çykarma.
explanation.ru:
Чтобы превратить утверждение в вопрос, поставь am/is/are перед подлежащим:
• She is reading. → Is she reading?
• They are eating. → Are they eating?
• You are working. → Are you working?
• I am late. → Am I late?
Форма глагола с -ing не меняется. Не забудь вопросительный знак.

examples.en: He is driving. → Is he driving?
You are joking. → Are you joking?
The water is boiling. → Is the water boiling?
We are winning. → Are we winning?
They are studying. → Are they studying?
The phone is ringing. → Is the phone ringing?

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Questions with question words in the Present Progressive
title: Present Progressive: Wh-Questions

explanation.tr:
Soru kelimeli Present Progressive soruları:
• Soru kelimesi + am/is/are + özne + fiil-ing?
  What are you doing? Where is he going? Why are they laughing?
• Who özne ise: Who is singing? (Kim şarkı söylüyor?)
• Soru kelimeleri: what (ne), where (nerede/nereye), why (neden), who (kim), how (nasıl), when (ne zaman)
explanation.tk:
Sorag sözli Present Progressive soraglary:
• Sorag sözi + am/is/are + eýe + işlik-ing?
  What are you doing? Where is he going? Why are they laughing?
• Who eýe bolsa: Who is singing? (Kim aýdym aýdýar?)
• Sorag sözleri: what (näme), where (nirede/nirä), why (näme üçin), who (kim), how (nähili), when (haçan)
explanation.ru:
Специальные вопросы в Present Progressive:
• Вопросительное слово + am/is/are + подлежащее + глагол-ing?
  What are you doing? Where is he going? Why are they laughing?
• Если Who — подлежащее: Who is singing? (Кто поёт?)
• Вопросительные слова: what (что), where (где/куда), why (почему), who (кто), how (как), when (когда)

examples.en: What are you doing?
Where is she going?
Why are you crying?
Who is knocking at the door?
What is your dad cooking?
How are you feeling today?

exercises.question: "___ are you laughing?" – "Because the film is funny."

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Rules – Present Progressive
title: Present Progressive: All the Rules

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive kuralları özeti:
1. Kullanım: şu an olan eylemler (I'm writing now), geçici durumlar (She's staying with friends this week), planlanmış yakın gelecek (We're meeting at 6 tomorrow).
2. Yapı: am/is/are + fiil-ing
3. Olumsuz: am not / isn't / aren't + fiil-ing
4. Soru: Am/Is/Are + özne + fiil-ing?
5. Sinyal kelimeler: now, right now, at the moment, today, this week, Look!, Listen!
6. Durum fiilleri genelde -ing almaz: like, love, know, want, need, understand → I know (✓), I'm knowing (✗).
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive düzgünleriniň jemi:
1. Ulanylyşy: häzir bolýan hereketler (I'm writing now), wagtlaýyn ýagdaýlar (She's staying with friends this week), meýilleşdirilen ýakyn geljek (We're meeting at 6 tomorrow).
2. Gurluşy: am/is/are + işlik-ing
3. Ýokluk: am not / isn't / aren't + işlik-ing
4. Sorag: Am/Is/Are + eýe + işlik-ing?
5. Alamat sözler: now, right now, at the moment, today, this week, Look!, Listen!
6. Ýagdaý işlikleri köplenç -ing almaýar: like, love, know, want, need, understand → I know (✓), I'm knowing (✗).
explanation.ru:
Сводка правил Present Progressive:
1. Употребление: действия сейчас (I'm writing now), временные ситуации (She's staying with friends this week), запланированное ближайшее будущее (We're meeting at 6 tomorrow).
2. Схема: am/is/are + глагол-ing
3. Отрицание: am not / isn't / aren't + глагол-ing
4. Вопрос: Am/Is/Are + подлежащее + глагол-ing?
5. Маркеры: now, right now, at the moment, today, this week, Look!, Listen!
6. Глаголы состояния обычно без -ing: like, love, know, want, need, understand → I know (✓), I'm knowing (✗).

examples.en: I'm writing an email right now.
She's staying with her aunt this week.
examples.ru: На этой неделе она живёт у тёти.

examples.en: We're meeting Ali at 6 tomorrow.
examples.ru: Завтра в 6 мы встречаемся с Али.

examples.en: Look! The bus is coming.
I know the answer. (not: I'm knowing)
He isn't working at the moment.

topic: Tenses – Present Progressive: Signal words in the Present Progressive
title: Signal Words: Present Progressive or Simple Present?

explanation.tr:
Sinyal kelimeler hangi zamanı seçeceğini gösterir:
• Present Progressive: now, right now, at the moment, at present, today, this week, currently, Look!, Listen!, Be quiet!
  Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
• Simple Present: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day, on Mondays
  The baby usually sleeps after lunch.
Karşılaştır: I usually walk to school, but today I'm taking the bus.
explanation.tk:
Alamat sözler haýsy zamany saýlamalydygyny görkezýär:
• Present Progressive: now, right now, at the moment, at present, today, this week, currently, Look!, Listen!, Be quiet!
  Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
• Simple Present: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day, on Mondays
  The baby usually sleeps after lunch.
Deňeşdir: I usually walk to school, but today I'm taking the bus.
explanation.ru:
Слова-маркеры подсказывают, какое время выбрать:
• Present Progressive: now, right now, at the moment, at present, today, this week, currently, Look!, Listen!, Be quiet!
  Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
• Simple Present: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day, on Mondays
  The baby usually sleeps after lunch.
Сравни: I usually walk to school, but today I'm taking the bus.
